name: marinara-agents
description: Pinned build dependencies for rebuilding Engine-derived feature packages. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

scripts.check: node scripts/run-parallel.mjs "npm run format:check" "npm run lint"
scripts.test:browser:noodle: node scripts/run-package-browser-tests.mjs noodle tests/package-noodle.e2e.ts tests/package-noodle-picker-scope.e2e.ts tests/package-noodle-keyboard.e2e.ts
scripts.test:noodle:regressions: sh -c 'for test in tests/noodle*.regression.ts tests/noodler-*.regression.ts tests/slurp-*.regression.ts tests/slurp2-*.regression.ts; do if [ "$test" = tests/slurp-phase1-durability.regression.ts ] || [ "$test" = tests/slurp2-reset-activity.regression.ts ] || [ "$test" = tests/slurp2-anchor-edits.regression.ts ] || [ "$test" = tests/slurp2-message-deep-details.regression.ts ] || [ "$test" = tests/slurp2-dm-write-again.regression.ts ] || [ "$test" = tests/slurp2-engine-avatar-variant.regression.ts ] || [ "$test" = tests/slurp2-restore-media.regression.ts ]; then tsx "$test"; else tsx --tsconfig tests/tsconfig.regressions.json "$test"; fi || exit 1; done'
scripts.typecheck:packages: node scripts/typecheck-packages.mjs noodle slurp2 long-term-memory memory-nag conversation-calls hierarchical-maps blackjack story-writer games saucelings otome-forge
